column3: Close to the Hebrew; “I rejoiced in those who said” is rendered “I was glad when they said.”
Close to the Hebrew; “A testimony” is rendered “An ordinance.”
Close to the Hebrew; “May they be at ease” is rendered “May they prosper,” and NASB quotes verses 6b–7 as the prayer.
Close to the Hebrew; “Rampart” is rendered “walls,” and “ease” as “prosperity.”
Close to the Hebrew; “I will speak, please” is rendered “I will now say.”
